limitations_and_boundaries: The BIC score gap on discrete benchmark datasets may be caused by the relatively simple autoencoder architecture, which is less successful in approximating multinomial distributions.
The method is demonstrated on synthetic data, benchmark discrete datasets, and a few application datasets; generalizability to other domains is not fully evaluated.
The polynomial acyclicity constraint is proposed as a practical alternative to matrix exponential, but its theoretical properties are not deeply analyzed.
The method assumes faithfulness between the DAG and the joint distribution.
